resources.string: Enter the course of your dream…
Here you can select persons to be associated with the dream. Add persons that appeared here, you thought about or that played other roles in the dream.
Here you can select the confidentiality level of this dream. Higher confidentiality means the dream is secured stronger, but less accessible. Check the settings for detailed explanations.
Here you can select emotions to be associated with the dream. Add emotions that you felt during the dream or describe your mood after waking up.
Set a custom title for the dream, or keep the default one that shows the date.
Set a note to capture additional information, e.g. bedtime routine or ingested food.
There are currently no emotions present. Use the '+' button to add custom emotions,
or add the six basic emotions as determined by Paul Ekman

The following matrix shows a visual representation of all emotions you have added. Emotions are classified by their 'valence' (mood of emotion) and 'arousal' (strength of emotion). You can click anywhere on the matrix to see which entry is assigned to which emotion.
